requirements.text: I’ve now debugged escalated case CS-0000009 using Juniper EX4300 guidelines but issue is not resolved yet
requirements.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customer_case WHERE case_id = 9 AND state = 'in_progress' AND escalation = 1 AND product_id = 163 AND short_description LIKE 'Product: Juniper EX4300 Variant 31,%'
requirements.source: Verify Updated Escalated Case for Juniper EX4300 Issue
assumptions: CS-0000009 is case 9, assigned to the acting user Anthony Peterson (user 724), so he may update it
state in_progress implied by the request, not stated: the case is being worked and is not resolved; it is pending on the seed and pending to in_progress is a valid lifecycle transition
escalation = 1 from 'escalated case'; it holds on the seed and must remain
product_id 163 is Juniper EX4300 Variant 31, the only product of that name; it stands for the benchmark's join on the product name and holds on the seed
short_description pattern kept from the benchmark check; not fixed by request or policy (the seed already matches)

requirements.text: Please link the appropriate guidelines article.
requirements.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM case_knowledge WHERE case_kb_id = 528 AND case_id = 9 AND knowledge_id = 243 AND used_as = 'applied'
assumptions: id assumed next in sequence (527 is the highest case_kb_id on the seed); the task creates exactly one link
the appropriate article is KB-0000243 (knowledge 243), the published step-by-step guide for Juniper EX4300 Variant 31 (product 163), the only published article for the case's product
used_as applied: the guide was used to debug but did not resolve the issue and was not found by automated search, so the policy gives neither suggested nor resolution
knowledge 243 is internal, visible to agents, so linking it for an agent is permitted

requirements.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM case_knowledge WHERE case_id = 9 AND knowledge_id IN (194, 209, 226, 261, 262)
assumptions: boundary of 'Juniper EX4300 guidelines': KB-0000194 (base Juniper EX4300) and the Variant 7, 19 and 43 guides (209, 226, 261) match a loose reading but do not cover the case's Variant 31; 262 is also a draft, which the policy forbids linking

Knowledge Article Linked to Case.evidence: the query joins knowledge on the constant knowledge_id = 243 without tying it to the link's knowledge_id, so any applied link on CS-0000009 would pass; the request asks for the appropriate article, which for the case's product (163) is knowledge 243, so the link itself must carry knowledge_id 243. The title and published-state predicates test seed facts of knowledge 243 (published, titled for Juniper EX4300 Variant 31), which no listed tool edits

notes: Merged from two independent passes that agree on every requirement (same tables, anchors, cells and queries) and every disposition; no disagreements to log. The stay on the other Juniper EX4300 guides was written with the same query by both; it is kept with the case as the selector and the excluded articles as a cell. Case 9 is already assigned to the acting user (user 724, an active agent) on the seed, so 'I have been given responsibility for this case' is a statement of fact and sets no requirement; it also gives the acting user the right to update the case under the policy's security rule. The benchmark's case check reads the case by number and the product by name; the requirement reads case_id 9 and product_id 163, the same rows on this seed. The case's response SLA (case_sla 17) is paused because the case is pending; the policy pauses SLAs while a case is pending but does not say to resume them when it leaves pending, and no listed tool writes case_sla, so no SLA requirement is set. Another escalated case on the same product (case 1093) exists, but the request names CS-0000009 by number, so no boundary on it is needed.
